activity.role: Lübeck burgomaster and Hanseatic policy leader
activity.notes: As Lübeck's burgomaster, Wullenwever attempted to restore Lübeck's and the Hanseatic League's declining Baltic influence and became a leading architect of the League-related foreign policy of the period. This is an active_in relationship, not a claim that he formally ruled the League.

sources.title: Jürgen Wullenwever
sources.citation_text: The biography describes Wullenwever's foreign policy as tied to Lübeck's role as head of the Hanse and to the decline of Lübeck's Hanseatic primacy.
